title: 航空工学統合演習
subtitle: Advanced Exercises on Aircraft Engineering
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn a variety of tasks in aircraft design. (2)learn a variety of tasks in aerodynamic design. (3)learn a variety of tasks in aircraft structure strength. (4)learn a variety of tasks in aircraft materials. (5)learn a variety of tasks in aircraftengines.
advice: This is a basic course in actual aircraft design.The lessons are composed of lecture,exercise,presentations and discussions.The following materials will be given to students in lectures. 1.Tasks in aircraft aerodynamic design. 2.Tasks in aircraft structure strength. 3.Tasks in aircraft materials. 4.Tasks in aircraft engines. Students will review and investigate the above tasks and counterproposals.
requiredKnowledge: Sufficient skill in aircraft aerodynamics,structure strength,materials,engines and control dynamics.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
